theorems.name: Submission.variation_deformation_calculus
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U K : Set (Rn N)) (φ : ℝ → Rn N → Rn N), (∀ r : ℕ∞, IsAdmissibleDeformation r U K φ → ∀ x, x ∉ K → initialVelocity φ x = 0 ∧ initialAcceleration φ x = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ (initialVelocity φ) x = 0 ∧ fderiv ℝ (initialAcceleration φ) x = 0) ∧ (IsAdmissibleDeformation 2 U K φ → (∀ t ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ U, ContDiffAt ℝ 1 (fun p : ℝ × Rn N ↦ fderiv ℝ (φ p.1) p.2) (t, x)) ∧ ∀ y ∈ U, fderiv ℝ (φ 0) y = 1 ∧ HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ fderiv ℝ (φ t) y) (fderiv ℝ (initialVelocity φ) y) 0) ∧ (IsAdmissibleDeformation 3 U K φ → (∀ t ∈ Ioo (-1 : ℝ) 1, ∀ x ∈ U, ContDiffAt ℝ 2 (fun p : ℝ × Rn N ↦ fderiv ℝ (φ p.1) p.2) (t, x)) ∧ ∀ y ∈ U, (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 0, DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun s ↦ fderiv ℝ (φ s) y) t) ∧ HasDerivAt (deriv (fun s ↦ fderiv ℝ (φ s) y)) (fderiv ℝ (initialAcceleration φ) y) 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
